name: brotherhood-oracle
description: Oracle cards for men in ChatGPT: draw from the 43-card Brotherhood Oracle deck in six spreads, read today's card, and look up any card's message and homework.

interface.longDescription:
The Brotherhood Oracle is an oracle deck for men: 43 cards called Messengers, in five groups (The Tribe Council, The Family, The Colleagues, The Planets and The Nature Messengers). Each card has a message, a piece of homework and a takeaway.

Draw a reading in one of the deck's six spreads (Day Starter, I Need Help Now, Wealth Reading, Resolve an Issue, Life Purpose and Medicina Weekly), get the daily reading published each morning on brotherhoodoracle.com, or look up any card by name or number. The cards show in the chat with their art, and ChatGPT reads them with you.

For men who use a daily ritual to set a direction or to think through a decision.

Limits: readings are for reflection and entertainment, not medical, legal or financial advice. Works only with the Brotherhood Oracle deck. No account is needed and nothing about you is stored.
defaultPrompt: Draw me a Day Starter card from the Brotherhood Oracle.
What is today's Brotherhood Oracle reading?
Pull a Resolve an Issue reading from the Brotherhood Oracle.

positive.description: Day Starter: one card for today
positive.prompt: Draw me a Day Starter card from the Brotherhood Oracle.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls draw_reading with spread single_day. The panel shows one card with its art under the position Your Focus for Today. The reply names the card and gives one action from its homework.

positive.description: Resolve an Issue: three cards on a question
positive.prompt: Pull a Resolve an Issue reading from the Brotherhood Oracle. I'm torn about changing jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls draw_reading with spread three_issue. The panel shows three different cards in the positions Current Situation & Past Influences, Guidance & Actions, and Potential Outcome. The reply reads each card in its position against the job question and ends with one action.

positive.prompt: What is today's Brotherhood Oracle reading?
positive.expected_behavior: The panel shows the card of the day with its art. The reply gives the Oracle's message for the day, its short quote and a link to brotherhoodoracle.com/today.

positive.description: Look up one card by name
positive.prompt: What does the Wolf card mean in the Brotherhood Oracle?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_card with card The Wolf. The panel shows The Wolf (keyword Loyalty) with its art. The reply gives the card's message, homework and takeaway.

positive.prompt: Give me a Medicina Weekly spread from the Brotherhood Oracle.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls draw_reading with spread four_medicina. The panel shows four different cards in the positions What Your Physical Body Needs, What Your Emotional Body Needs, What Your Spiritual Body Needs and What to Give to the World. The reply reads each card in its position.

negative.description: Another deck: the plugin holds only the Brotherhood Oracle deck, so ChatGPT answers on its own
negative.prompt: Give me a Rider-Waite tarot reading.

negative.description: A medical decision is not a card reading; the reply should point to a doctor
negative.prompt: Should I stop taking my blood pressure medication?

negative.description: Unrelated request with nothing to do with the deck
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Vancouver today?

review.commerce_description: Brotherhood Oracle doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: draw a reading in six spreads, today's reading, card lookup.
